method.module_boundary: Production sources form a separate optimized IlliquidCore module/object; driver imports and statically links it.
method.operation_unit: One FolderPlaylist.index(of:) lookup; each timed invocation batches 32 lookups.
method.sampling: Fresh processes in balanced AB/BA pairs; one untimed warmup in each process.
method.timer: Sum of DispatchTime intervals around 32-lookup batches; report values divided by iterations and operations_per_iteration. Construction, original-predicate oracle, and result validation outside timer.
method.cpu_timer: Sum of process clock() deltas immediately outside each wall interval, divided by CLOCKS_PER_SEC.
method.cpu_limitations: Includes wall-clock reads, CPU clock sampling overhead, and CPU use by all process threads. Tick granularity especially affects tiny inputs. CPU time excludes descheduled waiting, but still reflects processor frequency and cache effects.
method.primary_comparison: cpu_summaries median_paired_speedup; summaries retains separate wall-time statistics.
method.scope: In-memory index lookup; fixture decoding, construction, and sorting untimed. No filesystem scan or application latency measurement.
method.receipt_check: Every batch agrees with the independent original firstIndex predicate; exact decoded cross-process index/query/item receipts match; hashes are supplementary.
